description: Convert pressure between pascal, bar, psi, atmospheres, mmHg, torr and more. Enter a value once and see it in every unit instantly.

faqs.q: What is the SI unit of pressure?
faqs.a: The pascal (Pa), equal to one newton per square meter. Kilopascals (kPa) are common in weather reports and engineering.

faqs.q: How many psi are in one bar?
faqs.a: One bar equals 14.5038 psi. Conversely, 1 psi = 6,894.76 Pa.

faqs.q: What is the difference between mmHg and torr?
faqs.a: They are almost identical: 1 torr is defined as exactly 1/760 of an atmosphere (133.322368 Pa), while 1 mmHg is defined via mercury density (133.322387 Pa) — a difference of about 2 parts per billion.
